component.name: SuperAwesomeMagical Browser
component.summary: Browse the web, with your tabs down the side

description.p: Mozilla Firefox, as Mozilla releases it, in the SuperAwesomeMagical family's look: Lexend everywhere, the aurora's purple and green over cool slate, soft rounded cards and tabs down the left side.
The start page has a big clock and your most visited sites over a photo of the northern lights. Searches go to Ecosia. It keeps its own profile, apart from any other Firefox.
